lead_html: F2 Astronaut 16 is one of the factory scales on the Neotone One Mutant. This page shows its field table and three chord cards you can play from it, with the mutant notes that sit inside the main tonefields.
history_html: F2 Astronaut 16 sits on the DOME+9 hotkey. It has nine main tonefields around an F2 ding and six mutant notes, each inside the tonefield it pairs with. The other three tonefields hold no mutant note.
On a chord card the main tonefields are the large circles and each mutant tonefield is the small lens inside its circle. The A#m card strikes the mutant A#2 together with the chord.
